channel.title: IT services · Market Pressure Map
channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on IT services in Indian markets. Today: headwind (−1.3).

item.title: [−1] Services PMI rises to a four-month high of 55.8 in October; input cost inflation at lowest since 2020
item.description:
Below the 56.2 flash; new business grew fastest since June on domestic demand, but export orders were weakest since February 2023 and hiring eased. Composite at 56.2. Improving.

IT services: mild headwind (−1) — Weak export orders

Why it matters: Strong domestic services demand and easing costs support growth and inflation outlooks; weak exports flag risk for IT and business services.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +1, Inflation outlook +1

Confidence: high · horizon: weeks

item.title: [−1] Rupee gains 13 paise to 94.71 per dollar on foreign inflows and the equity rally
item.description:
Reverses Monday's 10-paise fall. Lower oil and foreign buying support the currency. Strengthening.

IT services: mild headwind (−1) — Lower rupee earnings

Why it matters: A firmer rupee reduces imported inflation and the cost of oil, while modestly trimming exporters' rupee earnings.

Market gauges: Rupee +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: days

item.title: [+1] Democrats are projected to win both the US House and Senate in the midterms
item.description:
Networks project a Senate flip and 218 House seats. US stock futures fell on gridlock fears. New political shift.

IT services: mild tailwind (+1) — Less visa-policy risk

Why it matters: A divided US government could constrain tariff and Iran-war policy, affecting India's trade terms, IT visas and oil risk; near-term effect uncertain.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +1

Confidence: low · horizon: months
